author: Jackobo
name: Jackobo Web API Service
description: A Jackobo.AspNetCore.Framework based ASP.NET Core Web API service with the standard Core / Infrastructure / WebAPI three-layer structure and a working sample endpoint.
//: sourceName is the token replaced everywhere (file contents, file names, folder names) with the value specified via -n / the project name in Visual Studio.

symbols.//RequiredParameters: AppTitle, ElasticIndex, RedisKeyPrefix and ApiErrorsPrefix identify the service and have no sensible automatic value, so they are required: 'dotnet new' refuses to scaffold without them and the Visual Studio dialog marks them as mandatory.

AppTitle.description: The display title of the service (JackoboWebApiOptions.appTitle), used as the Swagger document title. E.g. 'Orders API'.

ElasticIndex.description: The elastic index that identifies this service in the logs ('Logger:ElasticIndex' in appsettings.json). It is the same in every environment and every Jackobo log formatter falls back on it. E.g. 'orders-service'.

RedisKeyPrefix.description: Namespaces every key this service writes in Redis ('Redis:KeyPrefix' in appsettings.json). The framework refuses to register a Redis client without it as soon as a Redis connection string is configured - including one supplied later by the framework environment defaults - so it is set for every service. E.g. 'OrdersService'.

ApiErrorsPrefix.description: Short code prepended to every error in 'Core/Errors/ApiErrors.cs', so an error code identifies the service that produced it (e.g. with 'ORD', the error 'Database.RecordNotFound' is returned as 'ORD.Database.RecordNotFound'). Use a short uppercase acronym of the service name, unique across your services. E.g. 'ORD' for an orders service.

Framework.description: The target framework for the project. NOTE: this symbol must exist for the other parameters to appear in the Visual Studio 'New Project' dialog.

IncludeTests.description: Generates the Core.Tests, Infrastructure.Tests and WebAPI.Tests projects (xUnit v3 + NSubstitute), grouped in a 'Tests' solution folder, each with a sample unit test.

UseRedis.description: Adds the Redis configuration to appsettings. The framework registers the Redis clients by itself: ISharedRedisService when 'Redis:Shared:ConnectionString' is configured and IDedicatedRedisService when 'Redis:Dedicated:ConnectionString' is configured.

RedisType.description: Shared = the service uses the Redis instance shared by all the Jackobo services ('Redis:Shared:ConnectionString'); only the key prefix is configured here. Dedicated = the service owns its Redis instance and supplies 'Redis:Dedicated:ConnectionString' per environment.

choices.description: Shared Redis instance; only a key prefix is configured here.
Own Redis instance; requires 'Redis:Dedicated:ConnectionString' per environment.

RedisQaConnection.description: The dedicated Redis connection string (host:port) used in the QA environment. Only used when Redis is dedicated.

RedisProductionConnection.description: The dedicated Redis connection string (host:port) used in the Production environment. Only used when Redis is dedicated.

//primaryOutputs: Tells Visual Studio which solution to open/load after generation. Without this, VS may create only an empty solution and load no projects. The path is sourceName-replaced to '<name>.slnx', which matches the solution name Visual Studio expects.
